audits.purpose: Continue structured broad-gas closure across facilities not covered by Part116/119 and re-test the earlier Stoke target-year correction using independent APR year alignment without substituting APR into PI.
audits.stoke_integrity: The PI dual-year single value 10,200 kg aligns with the 2025 APR N2O mass 10.20 t, while 2024 APR is 4.00 t. This supports the existing conclusion that the 10,200 kg PI value must not be attributed to 2024. APR is used only as column-integrity corroboration, not as replacement PI mass.
audits.broad_gas_policy: Search targets are CO, HCl, HF, SOx and NMVOC plus other explicit non-particulate Air gases. No new target-year row was found across the eight facilities.
audits.prior_blob_policy: Previously retained/retracted rows remain reconciled to authoritative report blobs; repository search indexing is secondary.
audits.direct_raw_policy: No direct official facility PI row was consumed; confidence promotion remains unavailable.
audits.zero_policy: Absence of a broad-gas PI row is no-data, never zero.
